redCandidate.setup: Create an isolated workspace and issue 12 concurrent file-storage appendMemoEvent calls with distinct text through the public memo API.
redCandidate.expected: Every successfully returned event remains readable and the 12 canonical file-storage sequence values are unique.
redCandidate.observed: All 12 appends returned events and remained readable, but the assertion observed only one distinct canonical sequence value instead of 12.
redCandidate.failureReason: Concurrent appendMemoEvent callers derive nextFileSeq from the same pre-write JSONL snapshot because no canonical memo storage lock serializes sequence allocation and append.
